hero.title: File:Trenchcoat worn by President Gerald R. Ford.jpg
hero.source: Trenchcoat worn by President Gerald R. Ford
hero.description: Trench coat containing a bullet-proof vest liner. The coat is beige in color, contains 6 front buttons, adjustable sleeve cuffs, and two pockets, which are accessible from the inside.  The zip-up bullet-proof vest is made of Kevlar and is covered with cloth identical in color to the coat.  Sewn on the front of the vest are cleaning instructions and an issue date of October 1975.  The coat and vest weigh 6 lbs., 15oz.  Worn in public by President Gerald R. Ford after two assassination attempts in 1975.
categories: Aftermath of the Ford assassination attempt in Sacramento
